text:
maria: Heads-up — canary rollout for model-route "chat-v2" at 10% seems off. telemetry shows ~3% to canary, and some users keep hitting v1 despite cookie affinity being set. :thinking_face:

jon: deploy-bot shows canary started at 2145678800, traffic-split=10%. What's the routing key? are we using X-Client-ID header?

maria: yes, split key = header:X-Client-Id, fallback cookie=_rw_affinity, salt=abcd1234, hash=crc32

sam: quick snippet of rollout config:
```
route: /generate
split:
  - variant: v2
    percent: 10
    guard: "header:X-Client-Id"
  - variant: v1
    percent: 90
cookie_affinity: true
salt: "abcd1234"
```

lee: logs from edge show headers coming in lowercased: `x-client-id` and occasionally duplicated. Edge also strips original-case header when proxying. suspicion: hash computed on header name casing? :eyes:

ashley: we normalize header names in most places; our hash function concatenates `HeaderName|HeaderValue|salt` before crc32. If HeaderName casing differs between edge and runtime, it changes hash.

maria: aha — the app-layer routing expected `X-Client-Id` but the edge sends `x-client-id` -> different hash -> different bucket -> some sessions get rehashed to v1 despite cookie. That explains sticky bounce.

jon: runbook suggestion: prefer cookie affinity when cookie present, then header-based split. Also normalize header names in routing key computation.

sam: rolled quick fix: normalized header name to lowercase in the routing key code and added guard precedence (cookie > header). Patch: 
```
// old
key = headerName + "|" + headerValue + "|" + salt
// new
key = headerName.toLowerCase() + "|" + headerValue + "|" + salt
```

deploy-bot: canary patch deployed to staging at 2145679150.

lee: telemetry back to expected ~10% within 3 mins. no more repeated session flips in logs.

ashley: added unit + integration test for header-casing and cookie precedence, opened PR #412.

maria: thanks. follow-up: need a console UX hint to warn if routing key uses header name — note that proxies may lowercase headers. I'll file a small design ticket.

infra-bot: ticket created: ID INF-859. Punting to backlog but flagged for next minor.

jon: good catch. closing this thread — will monitor next rollout. :thumbsup:
